author: DaiqingChen
body:
Three FACIT collagen trimers have no annotations, I'm grouping them into one ticket.

The three child terms are collagen type XX trimer (GO:1990319), collagen type XXI trimer (GO:1990320) and collagen type XXII trimer (GO:1990321).

* **Collagen XX trimer (GO:1990319)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL20A1: Hs:[Q9P218](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9P218/entry); Mm:[Q923P0](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q923P0/entry); PMID:21421911.

* **Collagen XXI trimer (GO:1990320)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL21A1: Hs:[Q96P44](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96P44/entry); Mm: can't find Mm; PMID:21421911.

* **Collagen XXII trimer (GO:1990321)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL22A1: Hs:[Q8NFW1](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8NFW1/entry); Mm:[E9Q7P1](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/E9Q7P1/entry); PMID:21421911.
title: New annotations for FACIT collagens
